hypothesis: Explicit BTC forced-liquidation labels may recover a selective long opportunity absent from V58: forced short-liquidation buying may continue when post-burst price and public flow persist, while forced long-liquidation selling may produce a distinct exhaustion-reclaim long. These are competing causal mechanisms and neither edge is established.
decision: Accept the immutable development raw materialization as complete causal replay evidence but not as an economic disposition. Correct its mislabeled preregistration source-record field through the bound metadata sidecar and bind revision 12 directly. Freeze the statistical implementation below before inspecting any PnL or return value. Evaluate continuation_long and exhaustion_reclaim_long separately on the sole primary 5s_p95 arm and five-minute horizon after the exact 15-minute overlap purge. Publish all other arms, horizons, and regime strata as diagnostics with no rescue authority. Open validation only for a branch satisfying every frozen development advancement criterion; keep validation and pseudo-holdout sealed until the immutable disposition is reviewed and a new journal revision explicitly opens the next partition. Do not change V58.
falsifier: Reject the disposition if raw or correction hashes drift, a non-development record appears, episode-arm identities do not remain unique, return bps uses any denominator other than actual depth-walk entry quote, overlap purge occurs after outcome filtering, unresolved outcomes become zeros, bootstrap days or within-day observations are dropped, bootstrap seed/resample/block parameters change, the one-sided null is not centered, Holm is not applied across exactly two primary branches, any diagnostic rescues a failed primary branch, or the published advancement decision differs from the conjunction of all seven frozen criteria.

evidence.role: immutable raw development economic artifact identity
development-only raw coverage and no-authority contract
raw preregistration source-record label correction without economic changes
typed exact parsing, purge, point metrics, bootstrap, Holm, monthly, and regime statistics
denominator, purge order, stationary bootstrap, Holm, concentration, and profit-factor tests
fixed input/output and all-criteria advancement tests

statistical_contract.overlap_purge: within exact branch-arm-partition, retain earliest eligible entry and suppress a later entry when its decision_time_ms is less than or equal to retained entry_time_ms plus 900000
statistical_contract.purge_order: before horizon resolution filtering and economic summary
statistical_contract.unresolved_outcome_treatment: explicitly reported and excluded from economic means; never zero-filled
statistical_contract.return_denominator: actual exact depth-walk entry quote notional
statistical_contract.nominal_return_bps: nominal_net_pnl_usd divided by entry quote notional times 10000
statistical_contract.stressed_return_bps: stressed_net_pnl_usd divided by the same actual entry quote notional times 10000

bootstrap.method: stationary circular bootstrap over ordered UTC-day aggregates with every within-day observation retained
bootstrap.sample_length: same number of UTC days as observed
bootstrap.confidence_interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of raw bootstrap means
bootstrap.one_sided_null: subtract the observed all-observation mean from each observation before day aggregation; p=(1+count(null_bootstrap_mean >= observed_mean))/(10000+1)

statistical_contract.multiple_testing: Holm family-wise adjustment across exactly the two primary branch one-sided p-values at alpha 0.05
statistical_contract.monthly_material_negative_definition: a UTC month with at least 20 retained resolved primary observations and mean nominal five-minute return below zero
statistical_contract.concentration: largest positive episode nominal PnL divided by total positive nominal PnL

development_advancement_contract.logic: all criteria must be true independently for each primary branch
criteria: at least 100 retained resolved primary observations
largest positive episode contribution at or below 30 percent
development_advancement_contract.next_partition_behavior: a survivor remains report-only; validation can open only after a new immutable journal revision

limitations: Development is model-building evidence, not untouched confirmation; a branch that advances can still fail validation, pseudo-holdout, shared-portfolio replay, or prospective testing.
The 100-observation development advancement threshold is a screening requirement and does not satisfy the separate untouched-partition promotion minimum.
Percentile bootstrap intervals and the null-centered one-sided test depend on UTC-day block stationarity and may understate dependence beyond the observed window.
Reusing the same deterministic seed across branches and nominal/stress surfaces ensures reproducibility but does not create independent simulations.
Regime strata, non-primary arms, and non-primary horizons are descriptive and cannot support selection under this hypothesis.
The raw artifact's mislabeled source-record field is corrected only by the immutable sidecar; the raw artifact itself remains unchanged.
No economic result value had been inspected when this revision was appended, and no live change is supported.
